purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: medical advice; vocabulary (スキー/観客/体力/クリア/かける) in natural home.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 先生、最近、体力が落ちて。
lines.en: Doctor, lately my stamina has dropped.
lines.style: concerned office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 少しずつ、体力をつけましょう。
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm reassuring measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: スキーは、体力に良いですか?
lines.style: curious office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: スキーは、全身を使う良い運動です。
lines.style: clear doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 無理を、かけすぎませんか?
lines.en: Won't it strain me too much?
lines.style: cautious office man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 体に負担をかけず、徐々にクリアしましょう。
lines.en: Without straining your body, clear it gradually.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm caring clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 目標を、クリアできるか不安です。
lines.en: I'm anxious whether I can clear my goal.
lines.style: honest office man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 焦らず、観客のように楽しんで下さいね。
lines.en: Without rushing, enjoy it like a spectator.
lines.style: warm doctor voice, soft warm caring closing clarity throughout
